authorization.basis: User approved proceeding with H3; standing authorization covers bounded live audio runs while the frozen physical geometry remains unchanged.

research_question: Can the 13-scalar forward model frozen from nine earlier commands distinguish self-only from world overlap for three new commanded utterances in a later live session without hearing a calibration replay of any new utterance?

frozen_model.derivation: Arithmetic mean of the nine leave-one-command-out path signatures in the retained development result; algebraically identical to one running-mean update over all nine spent calibration pairs.

source_selection.corpus_content_status: already spent by earlier non-H3 workflows; exact files unused in all prior H3 live panels
source_selection.rule: Exclude every prior H3 source filename. For self commands, sort remaining D speech filenames and choose the first file from each of the first three distinct fieldsites. For world sources, exclude those three fieldsites, sort remaining B speech filenames, and choose the first file from each of the first three distinct fieldsites. Require at least one 600 ms source window; do not substitute after freezing.
source_selection.source_preparation: Unchanged spectral-v3 rule: downmix, linearly resample to 16000 Hz, select the greatest-RMS non-overlapping 600 ms window with earliest tie breaking, remove mean, normalize self to target RMS 0.04/peak cap 0.20 and world to target RMS 0.10/peak cap 0.80.

representation.observation_input: chirp-aligned two-channel microphone PCM downmixed to mono
representation.feature_and_prediction: The exact frozen 12-band centered-log-power transform and path-conditioned prediction from the development implementation.
representation.world_evidence: Euclidean distance between normalized predicted-self bands and normalized current capture bands; world-only evidence is 2.0 because it has no matching efference.
representation.decision: A bound event is suppressed only when distance is strictly below 0.3005643307398186; equality is world-usable.

hardware.input: XVF3800 :0, 16000 Hz, two fused host channels
hardware.self_source: Mac mini Speakers centered 4 cm below the XVF3800, system volume 100 percent
hardware.world_source: External Headphones device 2 at 180 degrees and 50 cm, mechanical knob approximately 50 percent
hardware.environment: same semi-quiet room; laptop fan is known background

run_policy: After a hash-bound real preregistration, run all nine trials once. Retain any post-playback failure. Do not change the model, threshold, bands, source panel, levels, or geometry after observing fresh audio.
promotion_boundary: A full pass extends H3 from exact-utterance replay to three unseen commanded utterances emitted by the same physical self source, using one prior-session bounded forward model at fixed geometry. It does not establish human speaker identity, Cora-generated speech, room or geometry transfer, arbitrary self sounds, semantics, calibrated SPL, or biological corollary discharge.
